about.text: A mold-ripened cheese known for its greenish appearance and crumbly texture. It is aged in clay pots or leather bags, where natural or introduced mold develops, giving the cheese a sharp flavor and soft texture. Commonly consumed in the Shirak Province, it is typically served fresh and not used in cooked dishes.
